verified_facts.text: The hotel is located near Cairo International Airport and Al Manara International Conference Center.

verified_facts.text: Mirage City Golf Club, designed by architect Peter Harradine, has 27 holes on two courses, including an 18-hole, par-72 Championship Course.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by European architect Peter Harradine, Mirage City features 27 challenging holes on two lush courses, including our 18-hole, par-72 Championship Course.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a man-made beach with an aqua park designed for children.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience the ultimate family fun at our man-made beach, complete with an exhilarating aqua park designed for children.

verified_facts.text: Mandara Spa covers 2,500 square meters and offers 30 treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: This prestigious Spa of 2,500 square meters offers 30 exotic treatments

verified_facts.text: Rooms have views of the golf course, resort pool or private beach, with deluxe marble bathrooms and soundproof windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy stunning views of the golf course, resort pool or private beach, along with deluxe marble bathrooms, soundproof windows and 24-hour room service.

verified_facts.text: Cabana rooms offer direct access to a pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Immerse yourself in tranquility with our cabana room offering direct access to a stunning pool.

verified_facts.text: The Royal Suite has a bathroom with a jacuzzi with golf views.
verified_facts.excerpt: featuring a king-sized bed, a bathroom equipped with a jacuzzi for golf views

verified_facts.text: Younger guests can enjoy activities at the Kids Club with the Family by JW program.

verified_facts.text: The Executive Lounge offers a quiet library and office facilities.
